fields.Name: T210 - Developer Tools GraphQL Console Run Query
fields.Description: Exercises the OnRun() execution path (query submission to the API + response rendering), not just the editor chrome that T193 covers.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the Admin app. Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click 'GraphQL Console'. In the query editor pane type a minimal valid query such as `query { __typename }` (clear any placeholder first), then click the 'Run' button (or press Ctrl/Cmd+Enter). Success is the console EXECUTING the query and rendering a result: a Response pane showing JSON and a status indicator (e.g. '200 OK') and/or a duration/size pill. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The GraphQL Console is open with a query typed into the editor and the Run button was clicked

After running, the Response pane renders JSON output AND a status/duration indicator appears (e.g. 200 OK, a ms/size pill, or a clear error status) - i.e. the query round-tripped rather than the editor sitting idle
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
